name: AR-NeRF
definition: An extension of NeRF that employs an aperture camera model instead of a pinhole camera model to represent defocus effects and viewpoint changes in a unified manner within a common ray-tracing framework.
summary: AR-NeRF is a NeRF extension using an aperture camera model to jointly learn depth and defocus from single images without supervision, unlike standard pinhole-based NeRF.
